tagline: A med-spa lives on rebooking — the first appointment is worth hundreds, the loyal client is worth thousands a year. We turn Body Wellness Connection into a 10-line Smart-DID grid where every injectable, laser, and body-contouring inquiry is answered instantly, booked, and followed up — so a first visit becomes a standing appointment.

insight: a med-spa client spends $300–$1,000 per visit and $3,000–$10,000+ a year once loyal — and the booking impulse is emotional and immediate. When the front desk is mid-treatment and the call rings out, that impulse books somewhere else. A phone number that just rings can't hold it. A Smart DID can.

pillars.p: A compliant dialer works lapsed clients and no-shows for rebooking — branded caller-ID, consented scripting, recordings. You refill the book from clients who already love you.
10 tracked lines + 24/7 answer + SMS. Every source measured, every service routed, every missed call auto-called-back.
Calls, texts, appointments booked, ad spend and source — one live dashboard. You finally see which promo produced which regular.

commandCenter.note: Every call feeds a real-time conduit your customized "second brain" analyzes on the fly — then you, or the AI, adjust the leads, script, offer, service, or channel and watch the book fill. You do the treatments — we make the phone ring.
